src8.text:
Dylan Harcourt was enrolled as a volunteer on 2026-02-14.

Eastgate Pantry Depot opened in 2018. Its coordinator is Priya Raman and its supervisor is Ines Carvalho. Cedar Hollow Depot opened in 2016, with Amara Okafor as coordinator and Dylan Harcourt as supervisor. Northfield Depot opened in 1974, and no coordinator or supervisor has been appointed for it. Lakeview Annex has no recorded opening year, so its founding is undocumented; its coordinator is Tomasz Wiśniewski and its supervisor is Ines Carvalho.

Pinecrest Middle School delivered a consignment to Lakeview Annex with a declared worth of 2475 minor units in MXN. It was received on 2024-11-14 and weighed 75 kilogram, and no best-before date is recorded for it. Maple Street Bakery's consignment to Cedar Hollow Depot has a declared worth of 999000 minor units in CHF and a best-before date of 2024-06-30. No arrival date is recorded, so the delivery is expected but has not arrived, and it was not weighed. Halvorsen Grocery Co. sent a consignment to Riverside Depot with a declared worth of 5000 minor units in GBP, a best-before date of 2025-11-20, and a weight of 310 kilogram. No arrival date is recorded, so that delivery is expected but has not arrived. Riverside Elementary School's consignment to Riverside Depot has a declared worth of 780 minor units in CHF, was received on 2026-08-17, carries a best-before date of 2025-09-01, and weighed 1875 kilogram.

Dylan Harcourt stocks at Riverside Depot, starting 2025-02-15 with no end date recorded. Ines Carvalho shelves at Eastgate Pantry Depot, starting 2024-08-02 with no end date recorded. Priya Raman stocks at Lakeview Annex, starting 2024-05-18 with no end date recorded.

Dylan Harcourt restocks at Cedar Hollow Depot, starting 2024-06-02 with no end date recorded. Amara Okafor restocks at Northfield Depot, starting 2024-03-19 with no end date recorded. Amara Okafor replenishes at Cedar Hollow Depot, starting 2024-11-30 with no end date recorded. Ines Carvalho restocks at Cedar Hollow Depot, starting 2024-09-14 with no end date recorded.
